status: pre-registered; final backend selected by a paired pre-start timing gate before any budget-study run

backend_selection.stage: completed before the formal budget output directory existed
backend_selection.benchmark_protocol: one new paired seed, clean and outlier_50, PSO and CS, population 80, exactly 8080 FE
backend_selection.reason: CPU KDTree produced identical fitted metrics and was faster end-to-end in all four paired cells; CUDA brute-force cdist is not advantageous for these low-dimensional 2048/4096-point searches.

purpose: Determine whether the PSO-CS difference is caused by search-budget limitations.

dataset.provenance: PMF-style reconstruction; not the original D5/D6 point clouds

budget_note: For population 80, exact fairness requires FE = 80 + k * 160. Values 199920 and 499920 are the exact compatible budgets immediately below 200000 and 500000.

reporting.paired_analysis: PSO and CS are paired by base seed within each condition and FE budget.
reporting.selection_rule: All five pre-registered seeds are retained; failed runs are not selectively rerun.
